infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: My Neighborhood Treasures uses the camera to scan barcodes (UPC) so you can check items against known price drops while you're in-store.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: My Neighborhood Treasures can use your approximate location to center the store radius map on your ZIP code.

plugins.cameraPermission: Allow My Neighborhood Treasures to use the camera to scan barcodes.
